info.title: laneway API
info.description: REST API of laneway. The web UI uses exactly this API.

post.summary: Logs in with email or username + password. Sets the session cookie.
Ends the current session and clears the cookie.
Creates a board in your personal workspace.

get.summary: A board with its columns and cards.

patch.summary: Changes a board. Fields left out stay as they are.

post.summary: Adds a column at the right end of the board.

get.summary: Recent changes on a board, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many entries, newest first (1-500, default 50).

post.summary: Adds a label to a board.

patch.summary: Changes a card. Fields left out stay as they are.

post.summary: Adds a checklist at the end of a card's checklists.
Moves a card within or between columns.

patch.summary: Changes an item's text or ticks it. Fields left out stay as they are.

post.summary: Moves an item within its checklist.

delete.summary: Deletes a checklist and its items.

post.summary: Adds an item at the end of a checklist.

patch.summary: Changes a column. Fields left out stay as they are.

post.summary: Adds a card at the bottom of a column.

get.summary: What this server is. Clients call this first.

delete.summary: Deletes a label and takes it off every card.

patch.summary: Renames or recolors a label. Fields left out stay as they are.

post.summary: Creates the first admin with the setup token from the logs, and logs them in.

agent_access_enabled.description: Agents (MCP) can see and use this board.

BoardDetail.description: A board with its columns and cards, both in display order, and its labels.

checklist_items.description: Every item of those checklists, in order per checklist.

checklists.description: Every checklist on the board's cards, in order per card.

estimate.description: Story points or hours, whatever the board uses.

position.description: Sort key within the column. Cards are returned in order.

label_ids.description: Labels of the card's board. The card ends up with exactly these.

position.description: Sort key among the card's checklists. Checklists are returned in order.
Sort key within the checklist. Items are returned in order.

is_done.description: Cards in a done column count as completed.

position.description: Sort key. Columns are returned in order; clients don't need to compare these.

columns.description: Starting columns, left to right. The web UI sends translated defaults.

name.description: 1 to 50 characters, unique on the board (ignoring case).

needs_setup.description: `true` until the first admin exists: show the setup page.

column_id.description: Target column, on the same board.

index.description: New place in that column, 0 = top. Past the end = bottom.
New place among the board's columns, 0 = leftmost. Past the end = last.
New place in the checklist, 0 = top. Past the end = bottom.

setup_token.description: One-time token printed to the server logs.

oneOf.description: A value sets it, `null` clears it, leaving it out keeps it (same for the fields below).

wip_limit.description: A number sets the limit, `null` removes it, leaving it out keeps it.
